title: PATHFINDER: Practical Real-Time Learning for Data Prefetching
problem: Neural-inspired data prefetchers suffer from high implementation costs for both inference and training. Current methods require offline pre-training on large benchmark suites, resulting in large models with high inference overhead that fail to generalize to data access patterns beyond the training distribution.
motivation: Data prefetching is vital for achieving high performance in modern processors, and enabling real-time learning could significantly improve practical prefetcher effectiveness.
method: PATHFINDER enables real-time online learning for neural data prefetchers, allowing models to train and adapt during runtime observation of data access patterns. Rather than relying on offline pre-training with large models, the approach continuously learns from runtime behavior, reducing model size and inference latency while improving generalization to novel patterns.
key_novelty: First practical real-time online learning approach for neural prefetchers that eliminates offline pre-training requirements and enables runtime adaptation.
contributions: Real-time online learning framework for neural data prefetchers
Reduced model size and inference overhead compared to offline pre-trained approaches
Improved generalization to data access patterns beyond training distribution
primary_theme: Real-time adaptive learning for data prefetching
